messages.subject: package vctrs vs devtools
parts:
Hi all,

I see I missed a report on these packages having conflicting version numbers or something:
vctrs
devtools

...neither of these is a direct dependency of BioGeoBEARS, but may be a dependency of a dependency.  I don't manage those packages, your best bet with a version conflict is to try to install slightly older versions or some such:

https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/vctrs/index.html
https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/devtools/index.html

Cheers,
Nick
